summary: Phase 4 complete: FormalSystem/Semantics/Presheaf/Behavior.lean gained Beh.ofGermOfSerialLimit, the binder-free germ constructor the whole Presheaf/Path.lean cluster routes through, marked 'Constraints consumed: Seriality, Limit' and naming IsRegular nowhere in its span; its body is ofGerm's former body with (F.nullity_identity w w).mpr rfl replaced by (F.toFibre.nullity_identity_of_serial_limit hser hlim w w).mpr rfl, routed through F.toFibre because no TaskFrame-level binder-free nullity wrapper exists (TaskFrame.nullity_identity takes [F.IsRegular]). Beh.ofGerm reduced to the delegating definition 'ofGermOfSerialLimit F F.serial F.limit w' with a byte-identical signature and the identical marker; germ_ofGerm, ofGerm_germ and germEquiv all still close by their existing proofs, so the plan's prepared inversion fallback was not needed. The module docstring's 'Frame constraints.' paragraph was rewritten (it asserted the Germs clause reaches the constraints 'only through the [F.IsRegular] bundle', which the twin makes false). PLAN/GATE COLLISION, carried forward: the plan names the twin Beh.ofGerm_of_serial_limit, but it is a def and check-module-invariants.sh C26 enforces lowerCamelCase for def/abbrev (theorem is exempt, which is why phase 3's theorem twins passed); the first gate run reported FAIL C26 at Behavior.lean:254 and the declaration was renamed to Beh.ofGermOfSerialLimit, after which C26 passes. The same collision will hit every def-valued twin phases 5-7 name with a snake_case suffix (PathHom.id_of_serial_limit at plan line 326, plus the toPath/ofStep/ofPath twins), so those phases must use lowerCamelCase for def twins. The plan's recorded Lean Challenge Statement for ofGerm_of_serial_limit was deliberately NOT edited to match, per plan-compliance.md, so lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --check would report a name drift; the recorded signature itself is honored byte-for-byte. check-module-invariants.sh C34a passes over 170 markers (168 before, +2) with the delegating group moving 26->27 exactly as predicted; C34b and C26 pass. The gate's overall exit is 1 from a pre-existing FAIL C16 at RaySummary/LadderPump.lean:1825/:1868, byte-identical to the phase 1-3 records and outside this phase's territory. Scoped build FormalSystem.Semantics.Presheaf green (1211 jobs, covering all four enumerated direct dependents plus the aggregator) and full library build green (GUARD_EXIT=0, 2974 jobs, zero error lines); sorry_count 0 with compiler cross-check MATCH; axiom count unchanged at 14. typst-sync-check reported drift (committed=404660 live=404686), re-stamped with --fix and re-checked clean. Gate 8 suite selection returns __FULL_SWEEP__ for these five paths, so the full gate set is deferred to the batch stage. Phases 5-8 (the remaining 20 over-reporting Path.lean markers plus the docs/counts phase) are untouched: this was a single-phase dispatch.
